// diagnostic E1013

Jet.BuiltinsOutsideCore

`jet_builtins` is private to Core

What

`jet_builtins` is private to Core

Why

`jet_builtins` is Core's one door to the operations, storage types and markers the compiler provides; only Core sources import it.

Fix

Import the public Core module that wraps the operation.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.BuiltinsOutsideCore: Tests/UI/core_builtins_private.stderr.
